pipeline.modality: Antibody-drug conjugate (ADC); fully human IgG1 anti-EDB+FN with cleavable linker and optimized auristatin (Aur0101) payload
pipeline.target: Extradomain-B Fibronectin (EDB+FN) in tumor extracellular matrix
pipeline.license_origin: Internal antibody; FACT linker-payload platform exclusively licensed from Pfizer

indications.indication: Recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (R/M HNSCC) — 2L+ monotherapy
indications.highest_phase: Phase 1 (planned pivotal study; FDA alignment received Q4 2025)
indications.trial_design: Open-label, multicenter, dose escalation (Part 1) and dose expansion (Part 2) at 5.4 mg/kg IV Q3W in two arms (post platinum/PD-(L)1; post EGFR/PD-(L)1)
indications.trial_status: RECRUITING; Part 2 target enrollment ~40 patients completed Q1 2026; updated data expected mid-2026
key_milestones: Pivotal monotherapy study planned in 2L+ R/M HNSCC

indications.indication: Advanced solid tumors (1L/2L+ R/M HNSCC, cervical, gastric, HR+/HER2- breast, TNBC) — combination with pembrolizumab
indications.trial_design: Open-label, global, multicenter, dose escalation (3.6-5.4 mg/kg MICVO + 200 mg pembrolizumab Q3W) and dose expansion in selected tumor types
indications.trial_status: RECRUITING; dose escalation ongoing; updated 1L/2L+ R/M HNSCC data expected H2 2026
key_milestones: Clinical Trial Collaboration & Supply Agreement with Merck (Nov 2024)
